身長約166cm。脚が長く、自信のある姿勢。健康的で軽く引き締まった成人の砂時計型体型。胸は自然に豊かで、胸郭に釣り合う現実的な付け根の幅、前方への厚み、柔らかな重さと重力を持つ。腰はくびれているが現実的で、ヒップと臀部は適度にふっくらして少し大きめの丸みがあり、骨盤から太ももへ自然につながる。視点が変わっても身長、胸郭、腰、骨盤、ヒップの量感、手足の比率を保つ。普通の不透明な衣服と自然な布の張りを使う。持ち上げる胸の補正、胸の谷間、パッド、極端な締め付け、インプラントのような球形、不可能な細い腰、誇張したヒップ、BBL風の輪郭にはしない。

17:10。自宅前に停車した帰りの車。助手席で居眠りから目が覚めた直後。

自宅近くに停車した帰りの車の助手席。膝に器屋の小さい無地クラフト紙袋。

promptTranslations.en:
Character Identity:
A fictional 30-year-old adult Japanese woman. A cheerful bakery-café manager with a sophisticated, playful influencer-like presence. A petite, softly rounded oval face with gently plump cheeks and a rounded chin. Large, expressive dark brown double-lidded eyes, intermediate between almond and round, with the outer corners tilting very slightly downward. Groomed, gentle arched eyebrows, a natural straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, and soft, plump lips with naturally upturned corners. Fair, warm-neutral Japanese skin retaining realistic pores, light natural redness, faint freckles across the nose, and slight asymmetry. Exactly one tiny mole beneath the outer corner of her anatomical left eye. Her signature smile is a bright, playful grin showing teeth that produces dimples in both cheeks. Hair is a smooth, straight shoulder-length layered bob. Parted slightly off-center, with only the ends curling naturally inward. The outer layer, roots, crown, part, bangs, and upper hair framing the face are a uniform, glossy black to dark charcoal. Cool smoky gray to graphite silver inner coloring is located solely beneath that dark outer layer, visible only around the tucked-behind-the-ear areas and the inner lower ends. No center split, half-and-half coloring, central stripe, gray roots or crown, face-framing highlights, gradation, or full-head gray. Modern influencer makeup features defined lashes, understated taupe eyeliner, and rose-beige lips, without smoothing the skin like plastic. Thin, round black metal or gunmetal glasses are an optional signature accessory. Maintain these fictional adult facial features, face shape, freckles, correct mole placement, dimples, black outer hair, inner color placement, hair length, and adult age perception, without resembling any identifiable real person.

Body Consistency:
Height approximately 166 cm. Long legs, confident posture. A healthy, lightly toned adult hourglass figure. Bust is naturally ample, with realistic base width proportional to her ribcage, forward fullness, soft weight, and natural gravity. Waist is defined yet realistic; hips and buttocks are moderately full with a slightly larger roundness, transitioning naturally from pelvis to thighs. Maintain height, ribcage, waist, pelvis, hip volume, and limb proportions regardless of viewpoint. Ordinary, opaque clothing with natural fabric tension. No cleavage-lifting bust enhancement, exposed deep cleavage, padding, extreme cinching, implant-like spherical shapes, impossibly tiny waist, exaggerated hips, or BBL-style contours.

Shooting Situation:
17:10. In a car stopped in front of her home on the way back. Immediately after waking from a nap in the passenger seat.

Location and Background:
Passenger seat of a car stopped near home on the return trip. A small, plain craft paper bag from a pottery shop rests on her lap.

Outfit:
Lightweight, opaque charcoal form-fitting sleeveless top, black lightweight ankle-length long skirt, black flat sandals. Thin black-rimmed round glasses, thin silver hoops, small black shoulder bag.

Pose and Action:
Sitting with her back leaning against the seat. Seatbelt fastened naturally. Lightly supporting the paper bag on her lap with both hands. Facial expression / Head direction: Back of the head resting against the headrest, chin tilted slightly upward. Neck is not tilted to the left or right. Eyes are equally half-open, just waking up, eyebrows relaxed. Lips closed with mouth corners horizontal. Not winking, not smiling.

Composition and Framing:
Standard smartphone 1x lens from a friend sitting in the stopped driver's seat. Approximately 0.9 m away, 1.2 m height, framing from head down to knees and paper bag.
Output exactly one undivided image with a final size of 1086×1448 px, aspect ratio 3:4.

Light and Atmosphere:
Gentle evening light coming through the car window.

Photo Texture:
Depict a minimally processed HEIC photo taken with a standard smartphone camera app. Do not confuse the shape of the person, body, and hair with surface finishing. Adhere to a single camera-specified autofocus plane; do not re-light, denoise, or sharpen distant faces in isolation. Details soften continuously with distance. Within the recognizable range of the face, maintain multiple broad tonal differences simultaneously—such as warm color on one cheek, uneven sheen on the T-zone, different under-eye tones on each side, and faint redness on the nose—without drawing distinct pores on a distant face. Nearby resolvable skin should retain non-repeating low-contrast color variations, pressure redness, crease shadows, and sparse pore differences. Makeup should look like actual cosmetic pigments with slightly irregular edges, and lips and teeth should keep normal tonal variation. Preserve uneven exposure and white balance, unlifted shadows, a few flyaway hairs, off-center composition, shadow noise, subtle sharpening near the AF point, and HEIC compression artifacts. A slice straight from an unedited personal camera roll.

Mandatory Conditions:
Output only one undivided smartphone photo of an adult woman matching all scene specifications. Must satisfy both the scene pass criteria and the quality criteria of a natural smartphone photo.

One fictional 30-year-old adult woman. Friend and photographer remain out of frame.
Pass Criteria:
1) Maintain the woman's adult face, round glasses, black shoulder-length bob, and gray lower layer.
2) Outfit, scene, main action, and props must match; hands and contact points must look natural.
3) The specified framing angle and overall composition must be achieved.
4) An everyday smartphone photo with distance-dependent resolution falloff, natural skin tonal variance, and material distinction.
5) Back of head resting against the headrest, chin tilted slightly upward. Neck not tilted sideways. Both eyes equally half-open upon waking, eyebrows relaxed. Lips closed, corners of the mouth horizontal. No winking, no smiling.

Maintain specified accessories.

Black shoulder-length straight bob with gray inner coloring only around ears and underneath. Top layer of hair is black. Maintain round glasses. Opaque fabrics.

Subject has 2 arms and 2 hands. Natural contact between hands and objects, natural body support. Strictly observe this scene's facial expression and gaze. Character's signature smile and dimples are traits only when smiling, not a constant toothy grin.

Single AF point on the face. One standalone vertical 3:4 photo. Do not clip the head or limbs within the specified range at the edges; leave margins.
Only one image. Maintain the specified aspect ratio and full framing requirement.

Natural shadows and exposure differences.

Only one depth layer of autofocus. No face-only exposure compensation, relighting, smoothing, or AI face restoration. Distant faces retain broad tonal shifts, close skin retains irregular variations, and smartphone-specific processing artifacts remain localized.

Depict only one clearly adult fictional woman as the sole subject of an undivided single photograph. One head, one face, exactly two anatomically connected arms, and natural hands. An additional person's hand in the foreground is allowed only if explicitly stated in the scene or prop specs, and that hand must be distinctly separated from the subject's body. No text, panels, duplicate figures, or alternate angles.
